company.description: HashiCorp is an open-source software company based in San Francisco, California. HashiCorp provides open source tools and commercial products that enable developers, operators, and security professionals to provide secure and run distributed application infrastructure. It was founded in 2012 by Mitchell Hashimoto and Armon Dadgar.

aiResearchSummary.text: Based on titles and abstracts, HashiCorp is researching infrastructure as code and cloud infrastructure management through systems and methods for managing multi component multi deployment environments, lifecycle management for information technology infrastructure, provider defined functions for an infrastructure as code workflow, and ticket based provisioning. They also develop discovery and routing service for a cloud infrastructure and routing visualization user interface, plus secure access via zero trust multi hop authentication and authorization and cloud based secrets management credential store. Together these efforts target infrastructure automation, cloud routing, and identity centric security.
